messages:
maria: Heads up — booking queue is stalling. Seen a spike in reservation_pending_count and lead times > 2h for several requests. UI: https://console.redwood/internal/queues/bookings Anyone on infra? :eyes:
ashok: looking. Do we have a correlation with inventory-sync jobs? I saw some timeouts earlier.
yon: saw this too. grabbing logs from reservation-service. snippet:
```json
\{"ts\":\"2026-03-18T09:11:23Z\",\"svc\":\"reservation-service\",\"msg\":\"failed to acquire inventory lock\",\"err\":\"timeout\"\}
```
sre-oncall: running quick query: `infractl reservations list --status pending --older-than 3600 --format table`
Output:
RESV_ID | REGION | AGE | REASON
r-1234  | usw2   | 7200 | waiting-for-capacity
r-1245  | usw2   | 5400 | single-az-constraint
r-1267  | usw2   | 3800 | waiting-for-capacity
leah: can someone check billing console? we had a billing hold on the billing-project earlier today. @billing-bot any alerts?
billing-bot: Billing alert: project redwood-dedicated-usw2 has a temporary billing hold (ticket BILL-4523). VM provisioning API returning 402 for new instances since 09:10 UTC. Estimate: $2.8k to clear backlog if we burst to on-demand.
ashok: that explains VM launches failing — reservation scheduler can't allocate. If billing API returns 402 we should fallback to reserved pool in another region, or mark requests as best-effort.
maria: can we do cross-region fallback? latency-sensitive tenants pinned to usw2 :/
yon: we could move older pending requests to a "best-effort" burst pool in use-west-2, mark them as non-SLA, notify customers. Script: `./scripts/migrate_pending --from-region usw2 --to-region use-west-2 --age>3600 --dry-run`
leah: cost vs SLO tradeoff: use-west-2 spot availability is high but preemptible. If we do on-demand bursts it'll cost ~3k as billing-bot said. prefer to wait 1-2 hours? need ops signoff.
ashok: quick fix: increase scheduler weight for existing reserved pool to prefer older requests: `PATCH /scheduler/pools/reserved {"weight": 1.5}` — that'll nudge allocations without new VMs. Risk: higher latency for new immediate reservations. ok?
maria: doing that now. patching scheduler...
sre-oncall: noticed a cascade: inventory-sync failing because of DB connection pool exhaustion. opening DB alert: DB-63. Might be root cause of lock acquisition timeouts.
yon: confirmed. stacktrace shows `sql: connection refused` from inventory-sync at 09:12. rolling restart of sync-worker helps.
maria: rolled restart of sync-worker in usw2; pending_count dropped from 210 -> 34 in 7m.
leah: awesome. billing-bot says hold still active but queue cleared enough that we don't need to burst. proceed with postmortem and root cause.
ashok: I'll own the postmortem with DB and scheduler notes. putting a tentative outline in ops-docs: https://docs.redwood/ops/incidents/inc-7891
maria: thanks. next steps: (1) ashok postmortem (2) add automations: if inventory-sync errors > 5 in 10m, auto-restart (3) add billing-hold fallback policy in scheduler.
sre-oncall: added incident: INC-7891, assigning to ashok/yon/maria.
leah: notify affected customers: ops-communications to send delay emails and offer credits if SLA breached.
maria: closing the thread — follow-ups in INC-7891 and ops-docs. :white_check_mark:
